projects.title: Group Research
projects.description: Addressing the common challenge in research where numerous ideas fail to materialise due to fragmentation—such as inspiration scattered across memos and discussions confined to chat logs—this project aims to create a one-stop research collaboration application. It integrates scattered keywords into coherent research concepts and automates literature retrieval, management and analysis. The long-term goal is to cover the entire research lifecycle, from the 'germination of an idea' to the 'publication of a paper'.

projects.title: Decree Farm
projects.description: Decree Farm is a gamified focus-management system that combines wearable hardware, machine learning, and an AI agent. A smart ring detects the user’s focus state and translates it into real-time actions in *Stardew Valley*, where the agent autonomously farms, waters crops, and harvests resources. Sustained focus leads to in-game rewards, while distraction triggers penalties such as lost coins and withered crops, turning self-discipline into an engaging and visible feedback loop.

projects.title: ScenicMind
projects.description: ScenicMind is designed for scenic area operation managers, using AI to connect passenger flow forecasting, operational indicator analysis, and decision-making reports into an automated closed-loop process. After uploading historical scenic area data, the system automatically performs passenger flow forecasting, calculates 8 key operational indicators, and conducts factor attribution analysis. It then leverages multi-agent collaboration to generate operational analysis reports that are ready for use in morning meetings.
